ha_attributes.title: Patch Wizard Setup Analyzer
ha_attributes.whats_new:
Introducing the Patch Wizard Setup Analyzer v200.48.

The authentication requirements to connect to My Oracle Support (MOS) has strengthened and as such, the following patch must be applied to connect to MOS.

Patch 31191999:R12.ADO.C for the latest version of Patch Wizard in Oracle E-Business Suite (Release 12.2).
-- OR --
Patch 31191999:R12.ADO.B for the latest version of Patch Wizard in Oracle E-Business Suite (Release 12.1).

Patch 31191999 updates the OAM connection to My Oracle Support (MOS) to authenticate using Oauth so customers can

  • Set or change OAM Credentials.
  • Download patches.
  • Download the InfoBundleR12.zip to Analyze recommend patches against their environment using Patch Wizard.

For R12.0 and 11i, automatically downloading patches via OAM or Patch Wizard, or the InfoBundleXX.zip is no longer supported.
The Patch Wizard Utility will still work, but individual patches or the InfoBundle.zip will need to be manually downloaded prior to running a patch analysis. For more details, please review Doc ID 741129.1 - How To Use Patch Wizard Without Setting Up Internet Connection.

The EBS Patch Wizard Setup Analyzer is a self-service health-check script that reviews Patch Wizard related data, analyzes current configurations and settings for the environment and provides feedback and recommendations on best practices. 

It is built on the Analyzer Framework 6.26.1.
